exposure: Bad blood pressure control despite therapy
outcome: Alterations in blood tests (platelet decreasing, high liver enzymes)
cohort: The study describes patients with chronic hypertension who developed severe preeclampsia with low platelets and elevated liver enzymes.
finding: An increase in total vascular resistance (TVR) before the decision to deliver in patients with chronic hypertension may precede the alterations in blood tests (platelet decreasing and high liver enzymes) indicative of HELLP/severe preeclampsia.
